claims.C1: a road is a drive plus a queue
claims.C2: rerouting helps only once the short road's queue costs more than the detour
claims.C3: drivers who know the usual traffic settle where both roads take the same time
claims.C4: rerouters fill the detour only up to the share needed
claims.C5: above that share, rerouters swing together between the roads
claims.C6: trip time against the share of rerouters
claims.C7: older information makes the swing costlier
claims.C8: trip time and trips finished against traffic

rules.time: within max(15 s, 25% of the predicted delay above free flow)
rules.gain: within max(15 s, 30% of the predicted difference)
rules.switches: within max(2 per hour, 35% of the predicted count)
rules.swing: within max(0.05, 30% of the predicted swing)

accept: a claim holds if at least 80% of its cases pass, counting only new runs when it has any (cases whose predicted delay is under 15 s are also reported separately: a constant free-flow guess would pass them too)
